sentences.en: Ben! Why don’t you have a rest and stop playing for a while? I’ve got homework. Ben!
sentences.zh: 本！你为什么不休息一下，先停一会儿呢？我有作业要做。本！

sentences.en: What’s up, Sally?
sentences.zh: 怎么了，萨莉？

sentences.en: I’ve got English and Geography homework. And you’re playing the guitar – badly!
sentences.zh: 我有英语和地理作业。可你还在弹吉他——还弹得那么糟！

sentences.en: Well, it’s my hobby and I have a good time when I practise. I love it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我的爱好，我练习的时候很开心。我特别喜欢。

sentences.en: Sure. But right now?
sentences.zh: 当然啦。可是现在呢？

sentences.en: Well, yes! I’m practising now, then I can do my homework later.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的！我现在在练习，然后晚点再做作业。

sentences.en: Well, can you do your homework now, please? The same time as me? And then practise the guitar later?
sentences.zh: 那你能现在就做作业吗？和我一起做？然后再去练吉他，好不好？

sentences.en: Erm … well, yes, why not? But help me with my Maths homework, OK?
sentences.zh: 呃……嗯，好吧，为什么不呢？不过你得帮我做数学作业，行吗？

sentences.en: Oh, all right!
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧！

sentences.en: Mum, can I take judo lessons?
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我可以上柔道课吗？

sentences.en: Judo? Really? What for?
sentences.zh: 柔道？真的吗？为什么？

sentences.en: Well … it’s good exercise, and some of my friends are learning judo, too.
sentences.zh: 嗯……这是很好的锻炼，而且我的一些朋友也在学柔道。

sentences.en: I think it’s a great idea.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是个好主意。

sentences.en: Really? Judo for girls?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？女孩子学柔道？

sentences.en: Mum!!
sentences.zh: 妈妈！！

sentences.en: Yes, a friend of mine at work does judo. She loves it and she says it’s very good for making her strong and keeping her healthy.
sentences.zh: 对，我单位有个朋友练柔道。她很喜欢，说练柔道能让她变得强壮，还能保持健康。

sentences.en: That’s right, Dad. And maybe I can make some new friends, too.
sentences.zh: 没错，爸爸。而且我也许还能交到一些新朋友。

sentences.en: Oh. Well. OK.
sentences.zh: 哦。嗯。好吧。

sentences.en: Thanks, Mum! Thanks, Dad!
sentences.zh: 谢谢妈妈！谢谢爸爸！

sentences.en: Jade! I think that’s kung fu, not judo!
sentences.zh: 杰德！我觉得那是功夫，不是柔道！

sentences.en: Harry! It’s time for dinner.
sentences.zh: 哈里！该吃晚饭了。

sentences.en: Come on, Harry. Dinner’s ready.
sentences.zh: 快点，哈里。晚饭准备好了。

sentences.en: Just a minute, Mum. I’m finishing something.
sentences.zh: 等一下，妈妈。我快做完一件事。

sentences.en: Harry, it’s dinnertime. Come and eat, we’re having dinner!
sentences.zh: 哈里，到吃饭时间了。过来吃吧，我们正吃晚饭呢！

sentences.en: OK, Mum.
sentences.zh: 好的，妈妈。

sentences.en: You’re always on your phone. Playing games.
sentences.zh: 你总在玩手机。玩游戏。

sentences.en: No, not games, Mum. Puzzles. I’m doing a crossword.
sentences.zh: 不，不是游戏，妈妈。是智力游戏。我在填字谜。

sentences.en: A crossword? Oh, I hate crosswords. They’re too difficult.
sentences.zh: 填字谜？哦，我讨厌填字谜。太难了。

sentences.en: I love them. They’re great exercise for my brain.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢。它们对我的大脑是很好的锻炼。

sentences.en: Are they? Well, OK. You know, you have to look after your brain, right?
sentences.zh: 是吗？嗯，好吧。你知道的，你得照顾好自己的大脑，对吧？

sentences.en: That’s right. Just like you look after me, Mum.
sentences.zh: 没错。就像你照顾我一样，妈妈。
